results.title: Power Rangers Dino Thunder: Collision Course
results.original_title: Power Rangers Dino Thunder: Collision Course
results.overview: Reefside is in for radical change when a strange intergalactic meteor plunges to earth transforming the Power Rangers' personalities. Conner turns intellectual, Ethan gets into sports, and Kira develops a strong sense of fashion she's never known! While Dr. Oliver is freed from fossilization, he is stuck in morphed form, and Evil White Ranger and Mesogog unleash more treacherous trickery. The Power Rangers will have to rock with amped ATVs and super Dino-powered teamwork!

results.title: Power Rangers Mystic Force: Fire Heart
results.original_title: Power Rangers Mystic Force: Fire Heart
results.overview: This disc includes the following episodes: "Fire Heart," "Petrified Xander" and "Scaredy Cat." Also included is the bonus episode "Ranger Down."

results.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue: The Queen's Wrath
results.original_title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue: The Queen's Wrath
results.overview: Queen Bansheera is out to destroy the Power Rangers, but when her henchmen, Diabolico, joins forces with the good guys, she really goes berserk and sets out to blast the whole city away. She turns her generals into giant monsters and vows to release all of the demons of the world at the next eclipse. Soon all will be dark. Evil will win. Can the Power Rangers find a way out of the damaged Aquabase and, finally, triumph?

results.title: Power Rangers Dino Thunder: White Thunder
results.original_title: Power Rangers Dino Thunder: White Thunder
results.overview: Nothing is what it seems as Dino eggs bring out a risky kind of Zord-play. A brand new alarm surfaces when Mesagog and henchwoman, Elsa, hatch a plan to stop the Rangers. The wily White Ranger is born from their blunder, and the Power Rangers have no idea who he is! As Dr. O is about to reveal White Ranger's true identity, he gets fossilized. The Power Rangers will have to work together closely to subdue rad Dino Zords and their most powerful foe yet -- White Ranger!

results.title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue: Neptune's Daughter
results.original_title: Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue: Neptune's Daughter
results.overview: Chad eventually discovered a mermaid named Marina who Chad developed a liking to, but the Demons have plans to ruined their little relationship.

results.title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers Live: The World Tour Live-on-Stage
results.original_title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers Live: The World Tour Live-on-Stage
results.overview: A performance of the Power Rangers live on stage.

results.title: Power Rangers Ninja Storm: Looming Thunder
results.original_title: Power Rangers Ninja Storm: Looming Thunder
results.overview: Cam is in need of the data disc for the Tsunami Cycles, which Dustin had last, but they are unaware that it's not only landed in the hands of the evil Thunder Rangers but has been used to give them their own Tsunami Cycles! This leads to the first confrontation between the Wind and Thunder Rangers, and as if the Wind Rangers didn't have it bad enough, they also face Zurgane! When the Thunder Rangers unveil their own Zords, can the Wind Rangers' own Zords withstand their awesome power?

results.title: Power Rangers Dino Thunder: Triassic Triumph
results.original_title: Power Rangers Dino Thunder: Triassic Triumph
results.overview: Something's fishy as Kira and Devin intern at the TV station and get hooked by Tyrannodones on the set! While Zeltrax and mutant monsters wreak havoc for our heroes, The White Ranger saves the Black Ranger and finally joins the team. White Ranger promises to be good, but now his nastier clone joins Terrorsaurus to confuse and crush all the Power Rangers. For this final face-off they must learn that even armed with the awesome Shield Of Triumph, trust and togetherness is the Power Rangers' best weapon!

results.title: Power Rangers Wild Force: Identity Crisis
results.original_title: Power Rangers Wild Force: Identity Crisis
results.overview: Zen-Aku, the strange wolf creature, is still confused about his identity. Seeking revenge against the Rangers, he is puzzled by his apparently human tendencies when he rescues a wolf pup. Animus, the lord of the Wild Zords, appears to help Zen-Aku remember who he is, but Nayzor tricks him and he completely forgets who he is again. During a lunar eclipse, however, Zen-Aku suddenly transforms into his real human form -- that of Merrick, a powerful warrior. Merrick explains to the Rangers that 3,000 years ago, he put on the wolf mask to defeat Master Org, but was then cursed to become Zen-Aku. Princess Shayla orders the Predazord destroyed, believing this will remove the curse. The Rangers vanquish the Predazord, and Merrick becomes himself again! Trying to set things straight, Merrick sets off to face Master Org, but he meets up with Nayzor and the Quadra Org as well. Can he defeat them? If so, will this once very old friend become the Rangers' new friend and stay with them?

results.title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Ninja Quest
results.original_title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Ninja Quest
results.overview: The Power Rangers face the challenge of a lifetime as they search for new powers. This pivotal saga begins with the introduction of a new enemy, Rito Revolto, who joins forces with his sister, Rita Repulsa, Lord Zedd and a host of monsters to destroy the Zords! Stripped of all their power, the Power Rangers' only hope is to journey into the treacherous "Desert of Despair." In this odyssey they struggle to find the mystical "Temple of Power" and Ninjor - the legendary Ninja warrior who created the original Power Coins. Meanwhile, Rito has planted eggs which will soon hatch into Tenga Warriors - the fiercest creatures in the universe. Can the Power Rangers obtain new powers in time to save the world from certain doom?

results.title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Lord Zedd's Monster Heads
results.original_title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Lord Zedd's Monster Heads
results.overview: When Lord Zedd peeks in on the Angel Grove High School Halloween Party, he decides to throw his own bash. After all, who could host a better Halloween party than the supreme monster maker himself?  Join Lord Zedd, Goldar, and their bumbling henchmen as they reminisce about some of the greatest monsters ever to battle the Power Rangers. This special episode features incredible fighting scenes with the meanest and ugliest monsters including Eye Guy, Silver Horns, the Pumpkin Rapper, Snizzard, Lips, the Terror Toad, and many, many more.

results.title: Power Rangers Ninja Storm: Nowhere to Grow
results.original_title: Power Rangers Ninja Storm: Nowhere to Grow
results.overview: The seeds of destruction grow out of hand as the Florabundicus fiend sow botanical bombshells to destroy the world. Disobeying Sensei, Cam gets in over his head trying to cut off crazy Kelzaks from the potent water source that will sprout an unearthly garden party. Shane powers to the rescue, but the other Rangers are totally in danger as flower power goes on a twisted rampage. It's going to take mighty Megazord strength and swift ninja swords to whack the wile weeds and send them into the oblivion they deserve.

results.title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Best of Blue
results.original_title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Best of Blue
results.overview: He's the smartest student at Angel Grove High School; a genius inventor able to solve any problem by relying on his brain before resorting to his brawn. He's loyal to his friends and is always there when he's needed. You know him as Billy Cranston, but the world knows him best as the Blue Ranger, and these are his most morphenomenal stories!

results.title: Power Rangers Ninja Storm: Prelude to a Storm
results.original_title: Power Rangers Ninja Storm: Prelude to a Storm
results.overview: Shane, Tori, and Dustin, three misfit Ninja students, have been endowed with the powers of the legendary Super Megazords! Earth's greatest protectors must battle sinister space aliens and menacing monsters! The mighty Ninja Storm Rangers must defeat the evil Lothor, a former Ninja whose hunger for supremacy got him banished from Earth. As Lothor's army rains terror on an unsuspecting planet, will the Power Rangers have what it takes to save the world? Only if they remember that it takes teamwork, trust, and friendship to save the day!

results.title: Power Rangers: Jungle Fury: Way of the Master
results.original_title: Power Rangers: Jungle Fury: Way of the Master
results.overview: Casey, Theo and Lily are at a loss when Camille, Dai Shi's second in command, employs the powerful Pangolin to launch an assault against the city in preparation for the resurrection of Carnisoar, the Sky Overlord. When they realize that the only way to defeat the Pangolin is to use the Jungle Mace, the Rangers seek out its possessor, the former Pai Zhua teacher turned hermit Master Phant.

results.title: Power Rangers Super Samurai: Rise of the Bullzooka
results.original_title: Power Rangers Super Samurai: Rise of the Bullzooka
results.overview: Join the Power Rangers as they go head to head against menacing Nighlok monsters, while also harnessing the mighty new Bullzooka weapon in these four Super Samurai adventures bursting with supercharged action. When evil Serrator unveils his mysterious master plan to enslave Earth, Jayden, Kevin, Mia, Emily and Mike must focus on the power of Ranger teamwork in order to triumph against Serrator's Mooger and Spitfang army.

results.title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers Official Fan Club Video
results.original_title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers Official Fan Club Video
results.overview: Congratulations Junior Power Ranger. All of the Power Rangers have made this special video just for you. They take you behind the scenes as you've never seen them before! So sit back and enjoy a Morphinominal good time!

results.title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers Karate Club Level 1
results.original_title: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers Karate Club Level 1

results.title: The Best of the Power Rangers: The Ultimate Rangers
results.original_title: The Best of the Power Rangers: The Ultimate Rangers
results.overview: Featuring Power Rangers from different teams as they battle evil across the universe, this compilation rounds up five of the best "Power Rangers" episodes that were chosen by the real experts -- the fans.

results.title: Power Rangers Super Samurai: The Super Powered Black Box
results.original_title: Power Rangers Super Samurai: The Super Powered Black Box
results.overview: Join the Samurai Rangers when their ongoing conflict with Master Xandred reaches epic proportions as he sends more dangerous Nighlok monsters to finish the Samurai once and for all. It's up to Mentor Ji and Gold Ranger Antonio to uncover the secrets of a legendary black box that will morph the Rangers into SUPER SAMURAI! By combining their extraordinary power symbols and Megazords to create new and incredible combinations, the Samurai become better and stronger. But will that be enough when a new villain surfaces, determined to defeat the Rangers once and for all? Includes 4 Megazord-powered adventures!
